The Science
What is Dermapen 4?

Dermapen 4 is the world's most advanced FDA-approved microneedling device — often called the 'Rolls-Royce of microneedling pens.' It uses 16 ultra-fine needles with precision oscillating technology to create thousands of controlled micro-channels in the skin, triggering your body's natural collagen and elastin production.

Unlike traditional dermarollers or basic microneedling devices, Dermapen 4 offers adjustable needle depth (up to 3mm), vertical stamping action (no micro-tears), and an inbuilt Scar Treatment Setting. This means safer, more precise, and dramatically better results for every skin concern.

Available at ISAAC Luxe, Dermapen 4 treats everything from acne scars and wrinkles to pigmentation, stretch marks, and enlarged pores. It also enhances the absorption of serums and growth factors by up to 80%, making every active ingredient work harder for your skin.

Precision Microneedling
How Does It Work?

Oscillating Needle Technology

16 ultra-fine needles create thousands of micro-channels per second using a vertical stamping action. This is far superior to dermarollers (which drag and tear skin). Adjustable depth from 0.25mm to 3mm allows customized treatment for every concern and skin area.

Collagen Induction Therapy

The controlled micro-injuries trigger your body's natural wound-healing cascade — producing new collagen, elastin, and growth factors. The micro-channels also increase absorption of serums by up to 80%, supercharging every active ingredient applied during treatment.

The Dermapen 4 Process
1

Skin Assessment

Our evaluates your skin concerns and customizes needle depth, speed, and serum selection for your specific needs.

2

Cleanse & Numb

Skin is cleansed and a topical numbing cream is applied for 20–30 minutes to ensure complete comfort during the procedure.

3

Microneedling Treatment

The Dermapen 4 glides across treatment areas, creating micro-channels while simultaneously infusing chosen serums. The procedure takes 20–30 minutes.

4

Resume Your Day

Mild redness like a sunburn for 24–48 hours. Skin begins healing and producing collagen. Visible improvement at 2–4 weeks. Results continue building for 3–6 months.

Versatile Treatment
What Can Dermapen 4 Treat?

Dermapen 4 treats virtually every skin concern — face, neck, body. Safe for all skin types.

Acne Scars

Inbuilt Scar Treatment Setting targets boxcar, rolling, and ice-pick scars. Significantly smooths scarring over a series of treatments.

Fine Lines & Wrinkles

Collagen induction plumps and firms skin, softening crow's feet, forehead lines, and perioral wrinkles naturally.

Pigmentation & Melasma

Safe for all skin types including Indian skin. Breaks up melanin and promotes even-toned, bright skin.

Enlarged Pores

Collagen tightening visibly shrinks pores. Skin appears smoother, refined, and poreless after just 2–3 sessions.

Stretch Marks

Dermapen 4's deeper needling (up to 3mm) treats body stretch marks by promoting new tissue formation.

Dull & Aging Skin

Overall skin rejuvenation — improved texture, tone, hydration, and a youthful, lit-from-within glow.

Your Dermapen 4 Journey

Most clients achieve optimal results with 3–6 sessions spaced 4–6 weeks apart. Each session takes 30–45 minutes including numbing.

Session 1 — Activation

First microneedling session activates collagen production. Mild redness for 24–48 hours. Skin begins its renewal process. Visible glow within a week.

Sessions 2–3 — Transformation

Collagen building accelerates. Scars start fading. Texture smoothing. Pores shrinking. Each session builds on the results of the last.

Sessions 4–6 — Optimal Results

Peak collagen production. Significant improvement in scars, wrinkles, and skin quality. Skin looks dramatically healthier and more youthful.

Maintenance — Every 3–6 Months

Periodic sessions maintain collagen levels and keep skin looking its best. Combine with serums and growth factors for ongoing rejuvenation.

Is Dermapen 4 Right For You?
Who Can Get Dermapen 4?
Ideal Candidates
Anyone with acne scars or surgical scars
People with fine lines, wrinkles, or aging skin
Those with pigmentation, melasma, or uneven tone
Anyone wanting smaller pores and smoother texture
People with stretch marks on body areas
All skin types — including darker Indian skin tones
Not Recommended For
Pregnant or nursing women
Active acne breakouts or infections
Recent isotretinoin use (wait 6 months)
Active eczema or psoriasis in treatment area
Blood clotting disorders or on blood thinners
Pre & Post Care

Before Your Session

Stop retinol and AHA/BHA 5 days before
Avoid sun exposure and use SPF daily
Arrive with clean skin — no makeup
Inform doctor of all medications and conditions
Numbing cream applied 20–30 min before

After Your Session

Mild redness for 24–48 hours is normal
Avoid sun exposure for 1 week
Use gentle cleanser — no harsh actives
Apply SPF 50+ sunscreen religiously
Avoid makeup for 24 hours post-treatment

Your Questions Answered
Frequently Asked Questions

Does Dermapen 4 hurt?

With topical numbing cream applied 20–30 minutes before, the procedure is very comfortable. Most clients feel a mild vibrating sensation. The vertical stamping action is gentler than dermarollers.

How soon will I see results?

Some patients feel improvements immediately after the first session — increased muscle firmness and toning. Visible fat reduction typically appears 2–4 weeks after completing all 4 sessions, with optimal results at 2–3 months as fat cells are naturally eliminated.

Is it safe for Indian skin?

Absolutely! Unlike lasers that carry pigmentation risks for darker skin, Dermapen 4 is 100% safe for all skin types. No heat or light energy — just mechanical micro-channels that heal perfectly.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes! Emsculpt NEO pairs excellently with treatments like CoolSculpting, Exilis Elite, and lymphatic drainage. Our experts at ISAAC Luxe can design a comprehensive body contouring plan tailored to your goals.

How many sessions for acne scars?

Mild scars: 3 sessions. Moderate scars: 4–5 sessions. Deep/severe scars: 6+ sessions. The inbuilt Scar Treatment Setting auto-calibrates depth up to 3mm for optimal scar treatment.

What's the downtime?

24–48 hours of redness (like a mild sunburn). Some clients experience mild flaking at day 3–4. Most return to work the next day with SPF. No heavy makeup for 24 hours.
